items.description: A provincial capital located at the base of the Andes, known for its colonial churches and nearby archaeological sites.
A town in Catamarca province famous for its traditional weaving, handicrafts, and scenic surroundings.
A productive town known for its mining, agriculture, and production of local fruits and nuts.
The capital of Chaco province, widely known as the 'City of Sculptures' for its hundreds of public artworks.
A key agricultural city in the heart of Chaco, known for its thermal springs and cotton production.
A city in southern Chaco that plays a major role in the local agricultural and commercial economy.
The capital city of Chubut province, located near the Atlantic coast at the mouth of the Chubut River.
A major city in Patagonia, known primarily as the center of Argentina's petroleum industry.
A Patagonian city with strong Welsh heritage, serving as an important commercial and paleontological center.
A premier coastal city known for whale watching and its gateway role to the Valdes Peninsula.
